rules.prepare:
export CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS -fvisibility=hidden -DLZ4F_PUBLISH_STATIC_FUNCTIONS -DLZ4IO_MULTITHREAD" export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS $CPPFLAGS" export LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS -pthread"
mkdir -p "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/_build" cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/_build"
cmake \ -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=Linux \ -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" \ -DCMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ -DCMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM=NEVER \ -DCMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY=ONLY \ -DCMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE=ONLY \ -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ -DCMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR=lib \ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo \ -DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE=ON \ -DBUILD_STATIC_LIBS=ON \ -DPKG_CONFIG_EXECUTABLE="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" \ "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/build/cmake"
